name: Lockjaw
lore: A clockwork crocodile built to pull jammed sluice gates free. Now he keeps watch over the Foundry’s lower channels.
passive: Pressure Valve: the first hit from a clamped target powers your next Snap.

primary.name: Snap
primary.description: Short bite. Stored pressure adds 9 damage.
primary.ui_brief: Short bite. Stored pressure adds 9 damage.

secondary.name: Clamp
secondary.description: Heavy lunge and bite. Slows and disables dodge for up to 6s, dealing 8 damage each second. Recast to release. Damage equal to 40% of your HP at latch breaks it. You take 15% less damage while attached.
secondary.ui_brief: Heavy lunge and bite. Slows and disables dodge for up to 6s, dealing 8 damage each second. Recast to release. Damage equal to 40% of your HP at latch breaks it. You take 15% less damage while attached.

special.name: Spring Jaw
special.description: Hold your jaws open for up to 5 seconds. The first incoming hit is reduced and triggers a counterbite. Press Special again to snap early.
special.ui_brief: Hold your jaws open for up to 5 seconds. The first incoming hit is reduced and triggers a counterbite. Press Special again to snap early.
